d:
At Lallantop Bihar Adda Deepak Thakur, Singer, composer opens up about his performing at local functions, his unexpected discovery by filmmaker Anurag Kashyap, and how he landed his break singing iconic tracks in Gangs of Wasseypur. He also shares behind-the-scenes stories of his selection process for Bigg Boss 12, his memorable stint inside the house as a 'commoner' contestant, and how the reality show transformed his life overnight. Watch the Video to know more.
